method: Pre-fix reproduction via the contract's real proof path: copy the committed nativewind template files OUTSIDE the monorepo (os.tmpdir-derived), run the verbatim `packages/docs-snippets/commands/nativewind.sh` recipe (pnpm install -> npx expo install -> five literal RNR CLI adds -> doctor/tsc/expo-doctor) with cwd = the copy, overlay `app/index.tsx` + the shared quickstart screen, then `npx expo export --platform web`.
expected_failure: Unable to resolve module react-native-css-interop/jsx-runtime from app/index.tsx
observed_failure: Error: Unable to resolve module react-native-css-interop/jsx-runtime from /Users/justinrich/.cache/agent-scratch/fix-nw-red-qFghbv/app/index.tsx: react-native-css-interop/jsx-runtime could not be found within the project or in these directories:
root_cause: react-native-css-interop@0.2.6 is declared by nativewind@4.2.6 but pnpm's isolated linker nests it under .pnpm/nativewind@4.2.6_.../node_modules/react-native-css-interop and never hoists it to the consumer root; the babel-preset-expo jsxImportSource:'nativewind' injected `import 'react-native-css-interop/jsx-runtime'` therefore cannot resolve from app files.
